2014_spells.void-writing.description: You can write on any surface, but the writing is visible only to creatures you specify. The writing appears on the surface as normal writing, but it is invisible to all other creatures. The writing can be revealed only by a see invisibility spell or similar magic. The writing lasts for the duration, but it can be ended early by you as a bonus action. At 5th level, the writing can be revealed only by a see invisibility spell or similar magic, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and speaks a word that you designate when you cast the spell. At 11th level, the writing can be revealed only by a see invisibility spell or similar magic, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and speaks a word that you designate when you cast the spell, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and uses an action to make a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check. At 17th level, the writing can be revealed only by a see invisibility spell or similar magic, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and speaks a word that you designate when you cast the spell, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and uses an action to make a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check, and it can also be revealed by a creature that touches the surface and uses an action to make a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.
2014_spells.void-writing.effectSummary: Make a creature invisible until it attacks or the spell ends
